profile_text.body:
Wipro is a technology services and consulting company that describes itself as consulting-led and AI-powered. According to its own site, it blends consulting and AI expertise across design, engineering and operations, with the stated aim of accelerating business transformation and delivering what it calls future-ready technology. The company presents itself as a global leader in this work.

Wipro is a public company, traded under the ticker WIT, and it appears in SEC records under CIK 0001123799. Beyond that, the material available here is limited: no specific AI products, lawsuits, or other tracked items are recorded for the company.
